findings.finding: Performance escort versus honest cohabitation answer; A offers presence or postponement, not universal reassurance. D106-b redundant A5 preface removed and safety option made explicit.
Anniversary relationship doubt versus reunion fear of being unwanted. A reveals real additional information rather than asking generic questions; B attention or hurt causes the final admission.
Employee relieves boss morale duty; friend removes hospitality guarantee. Tea replaces a would-be second meal so the visit remains coherent.
Actual van cancellations require replacement work; an angry treasurer changes the call order. Both keep A fear as the cause without requiring B to endorse the cover story.
Unopened opportunity versus timed departure. B solutions become the next practical tasks; A offers washing/labeling or bag holding to keep B engaged.
